Team —

I ran a quick hygiene pass on the Q2 pipeline and attached a compact R/Y/G export (Q2_RYG_SavePlan_20260518.xlsx). Highlights and asks below:

- Yellow (watch): RDW-2268 (BetaWorks), RDW-2301 (FinOpt) — awaiting final technical signoff; likely to close if no further blockers.
- Green (on-track): obvious ones I left alone.

Finance (Laura) — if we can reclassify any Red->Yellow with a committed signature ETA, that helps the forecast.

- Owner: Karthik
- Action: Arrange procurement call this week; legal to accept SOW v3 or return redlines by 05/20. I attached the current SOW (RDW-2345-draft-SOW-v3.pdf).
- Contingency: If no redlines by 05/20, propose 50% revenue recognition in Q2 with remainder in Q3 and offer a limited pilot discount to accelerate signature.

Can each of you add a one-line status in the sheet and reply here with any blockers you want me to escalate? I’ll open a HubSpot note at the link below for each save plan so finance can track.

Also, Karthik — please push the HubSpot note (link) and include the SOW version. I want to be able to trace audit evidence if we decide to recognize partial revenue.
